caseNameFull: Mohawk Mining Company v. Harry H. Weiss, Collector of Internal Revenue, etc.

opinions.text: October 18, 1920. Petition for a writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit denied. Mr. Alton C. Dustin for petitioner. The Solicitor General and Mrs. Annette Abbott Adams, Assistant Attorney General, for respondent.
